pre_injection_review: Lead explicitly reviewed and approved this phase matrix in collaboration message before first transfer injection. Expected authority/custody was discussed against phases.rs source.
mechanism: Unmodified pinned CLI under external LLDB source breakpoint; actual stop frame and SIGKILL result retained. Connect host-kill rows separately cover preinstall/installed-prerecord/postrecord custody; child permitted to finish, then fresh reads and no replay.
important: Progress is not a synchronization gate: transfer progress precedes persisted op and backup progress can be buffered. The debugger supplies exact boundary evidence.
